reason: It is free this term, so my son will use it because the teacher checks it, but I am not paying ₹299 a month until I see the re-test show his gaps actually closed. I paid for a big learning app once and he dropped it in three weeks.
objection: Once the school stops checking it in class, he will stop using it like the last app, and YouTube and free apps already cover the same chapters.
would_change_my_mind: If the end-of-term re-test shows clear improvement and the teacher tells me at the parent-teacher meeting that it helped, and the school keeps assigning it as homework next term.
